runtimeAudit.note: 7.1.34 Stage 4 adds student-side Google Forms submission on top of the Stage 3 teacher-side CSV importer. Only validated HTTPS responder URLs on docs.google.com/forms ... /viewform or forms.gle are accepted; the URL is a local generator setting and becomes integrity-bound only in newly generated secure student packages. After secure submission the student copies the complete SECURE-ANSWERS-V1 payload and opens the school form. answers.txt remains an emergency fallback and is automatic when no form is configured or the payload exceeds the conservative 24000-character threshold. The secure result format, RSA-OAEP/AES-GCM cryptography, scoring, PIN/unlock and Stage 3 verifier are unchanged. Targeted local Chromium regression is executed; full exact-lockfile browser/runtime regression remains pending clean GitHub CI.
